title: A famous actress 著名的女演员
description: A dialogue between Kate and Liz, who recognize a famous actress (Karen Marsh) and an actor (Conrad Reeves) at a restaurant. They discuss whether the man is her third, fourth or fifth husband, and note that Karen looks old for her age (twenty-nine but must be at least forty). Liz reveals she is not more than twenty-nine herself. The lesson introduces the words famous, actress, actor, read and at least, and the grammar of 'must be' (deduction) and 'can't be' (negative deduction).
answer_note: The listening comprehension question is a model answer (suggested). Workbook A (Complete the dialogue) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-123-129.jpg p.215). Workbook B (I think so. I don't think so. I hope so. I hope not.) is from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-123-129.jpg p.215). Grammar I (rewrite using 'can't be/do'), II (rewrite using 'must be/do') and III (rewrite using 'must', 'can't' or 'can') are from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.563-564).

lesson.text: Listen to the tape then answer this question. Who is only twenty-nine, and why is it so unclear? 听录音，然后回答问题。谁只有29岁？为什么这件事如此含糊不清？
lesson.translation: 听录音，然后回答问题。谁只有29岁？为什么这件事如此含糊不清？

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: Can you recognize that woman, Liz?
lines.translation: 莉兹，你能认出那个女人吗？

lines.speaker: LIZ
lines.text: I think I can, Kate. It must be Karen Marsh, the actress.
lines.translation: 我想我认得出来，凯特。那一定是女演员卡伦·马什。

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: I thought so. Who's that beside her?
lines.translation: 我也这样想。她旁边的那个人是谁？

lines.speaker: LIZ
lines.translation: 那一定是康拉德·里弗斯。

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: Conrad Reeves, the actor? It can't be. Let me have another look. I think you're right! Isn't he her third husband?
lines.translation: 康拉德·里弗斯，那个男演员吗？不可能是。让我再看一看。我想你是对的！他不是她的第3个丈夫吗？

lines.speaker: LIZ
lines.text: No. He must be her fourth or fifth.
lines.translation: 不。他一定是她的第4个或第5个丈夫。

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.translation: 卡伦·马什看上去不显老嘛！

lines.speaker: LIZ
lines.text: She does, doesn't she! I read she's twenty-nine, but she must be at least forty.
lines.translation: 是的，谁说不是呢！我从报上看到她是29岁，但她一定至少有40岁了。

lines.speaker: LIZ
lines.text: She was a famous actress when I was still at school.
lines.translation: 当我还是学生时，她就是个著名的演员了。

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.text: That was a long time ago, wasn't it?
lines.translation: 那是好久以前的事了，是吗？

lines.speaker: LIZ
lines.text: Not that long ago! I'm not more than twenty-nine myself.
lines.translation: 不。没有那么久。我自己现在还没29岁呢。

lesson.title: Who is only twenty-nine, and why is it so unclear?
lesson.instruction: Answer the question. 回答这个问题。
lesson.context: Comprehension question about who is twenty-nine and why it is unclear.

questions.prompt: Who is only twenty-nine, and why is it so unclear?
questions.answer: Liz is not more than twenty-nine herself. It is unclear because Karen Marsh reads as twenty-nine but looks at least forty, and Liz was still at school when Karen was already famous.

items.title: 1. must be / can't be
items.text: must be 是英文中用来表示根据事实所作的推论，往往译为「一定」。must be 的否定式是 can't be，如 Kate 的话「It can't be.」是对 Liz 的推论（「That must be Conrad Reeves.」）的否定。同时，请注意这里的 can't be（表示不可能）和第45课中 I can't type this letter.（表示能力）的区别。

items.title: 3. her fourth or fifth
items.text: her fourth or fifth 后面省略了 husband。

items.title: 4. Not that long ago!
items.text: 句中的 that 是副词、指像 Kate 所说的「那么」遥远，可译作「那样」、「那么」。课文中用斜体印刷表示一种强调，显然 Liz 对 Kate 的判断和对她本人年龄的估算很不满意。

practice.title: Practice B: I think so. I don't think so. I hope so. I hope not.
practice.instruction: Someone is asking you questions about a woman you know. Write short answers with I think so or I don't think so or I hope so or I hope not. 有人在向你打听一位你认识的女士，用 I think so 或 I don't think so 或 I hope so 或 I hope not 来回答以下问题。
practice.translation: 有人在向你打听一位你认识的女士，用 I think so 或 I don't think so 或 I hope so 或 I hope not 来回答以下问题。

grammar.title: Grammar I: Rewrite the sentences using 'can't be/do' according to the example
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用 can't be/do 改写下列句子。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 can't be/do 改写下列句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.563 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 12 rewrite items using 'can't be/do'; item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: I don't believe it's true.
I don't believe it's cold outside.
I don't believe that you are right.
I don't believe she is sixty years old.
questions.answer: She can't be sixty years old.

questions.prompt: I don't believe the book costs two hundred pounds.
questions.answer: The book can't cost two hundred pounds.

questions.prompt: I don't believe it's eleven thirty.
I don't believe he is so careless.
I don't believe she is our new teacher.
questions.answer: She can't be our new teacher.

questions.prompt: I don't believe he is fifty.
I don't believe he is ill.
I don't believe they're farmers.
I don't believe it's so hot there.
questions.answer: It can't be so hot there.

grammar.title: Grammar II: Rewrite the sentences using 'must be/do' according to the example
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用 must be/do 改写下列句子。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 must be/do 改写下列句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.563 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 12 rewrite items using 'must be/do'; item 1 is the printed example.

questions.prompt: I think he is ill.
I think he is an actor.
I think she's twenty years old.
questions.answer: She must be twenty years old.

questions.prompt: I think he is a careful man.
questions.answer: He must be a careful man.

questions.prompt: I think there is some water in the kettle.
questions.answer: There must be some water in the kettle.

questions.prompt: I think they have enough money for it.
questions.answer: They must have enough money for it.

questions.prompt: I think the pen is worth only ten yuan.
questions.answer: The pen must be worth only ten yuan.

questions.prompt: I think you are very clever.
I think they're businessmen.
I think it's about six o'clock.
questions.answer: It must be about six o'clock.

questions.prompt: I think he is very intelligent.
I think you are very tired.

grammar.title: Grammar III: Rewrite the sentences using 'must', 'can't' or 'can' according to the examples
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句用 must, can't 或 can 改写下列句子。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句用 must, can't 或 can 改写下列句子。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.563-564 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 20 rewrite items using 'must', 'can't' or 'can'; items 1-3 are the printed examples.

questions.prompt: I have to wash some clothes.
It's impossible that he is in the library.
questions.answer: He can't be in the library.

questions.prompt: He swims well.
You speak French well.
He is having a bath now (certain).
questions.answer: He must be having a bath now.

questions.prompt: She cleans the house every day (obligation).
questions.answer: She must clean the house every day.

questions.prompt: She is fifty (impossible).
They are students (certain).
You must read this book (obligation).
He is watching television (impossible).
They are on their way home (certain).
questions.answer: They must be on their way home.

questions.prompt: That man runs very fast (ability).
questions.answer: That man can run very fast.

questions.prompt: That house is very expensive (impossible).
questions.answer: That house can't be very expensive.

questions.prompt: Today is July 23rd (certain).
She is very rich (impossible).
They are having a lesson now (certain).
questions.answer: They must be having a lesson now.

questions.prompt: The girl writes very well (ability).
questions.answer: The girl can write very well.

questions.prompt: You correct all their mistakes (obligation).
questions.answer: You must correct all their mistakes.

questions.prompt: Your son is a clever boy (certain).
questions.answer: Your son must be a clever boy.

questions.prompt: She is at home (impossible).
